10 recipes you’ll love from Jamie Oliver’s 20 Minute Meals

by Rachel Deeley

published on 10 September 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:07
Instaread

There’s no one we trust more than Jamie Oliver to provide us with speedy, simple, fresh, and delicious cooking inspiration, so it’s little wonder that his latest cookbook will help you have dinner on the table in 20 minutes or less.

With 20 Minute Meals, Jamie has created 120 recipes that really do take just a matter of minutes to whip up – covering everything from pasta, rice and noodle dishes, hearty beans and pulses, fish and seafood favourites, next-level eggs, dinner-worthy soups, and even a whole chapter dedicated to chicken. What’s more you’ll find plenty of clever tips, kitchen hacks, and vegetarian friendly swaps throughout, so you can create something perfect and tasty for any occasion,

To give you a taste of what you’ll find inside 20 Minute Meals, we’ve rounded up the must-try recipes you’ll want to be whipping up in no time.

Jamie Oliver’s Pressure Cooker Bolognese

by Jamie Oliver
from 20 Minute Meals: Dinner in 20 Minutes or Less

A homemade bolognese in 20 minutes? Sounds too good to be true, but it’s not. Using a pressure cooker helps speed things up immensely, so you can have the perfect comforting bowl of pasta with none of the faff or wait.

Jamie Oliver’s Fish Pie Pasta Bake

by Jamie Oliver
from 20 Minute Meals: Dinner in 20 Minutes or Less

Another clever pasta recipe sees Jamie swap potato for macaroni in this fish pie with a twist – complete with a deliciously savoury, creamy sauce, a golden cheddar topping, and the addition of frozen spinach so you can get your greens in.

Jamie Oliver’s Wasabi Steak Skewers

by Jamie Oliver
from 20 Minute Meals: Dinner in 20 Minutes or Less

Thin strips of sesame-encrusted steaks make for wonderfully tasty skewers in this inventive dinner recipe, best served on a bed of rice, fresh steamed pak choi and asparagus, and drizzled with flavour-packed teriyaki sauce.

Jamie Oliver’s Easy Cheesy Ham Filo Quichy

by Jamie Oliver
from 20 Minute Meals: Dinner in 20 Minutes or Less

We all love a homemade quiche, but shortcrust pastry can be fiddly and time-consuming. Enter this clever hack from Jamie, layering sheets of filo pastry and spritzes of oil to create a deliciously crispy base and crust in no time at all.

Preview: Saffron Cauli & Sticky Onions

by Jamie Oliver
from 20 Minute Meals: Dinner in 20 Minutes or Less

The perfect platter for any discerning vegetarian, this recipe uses a clever cooking hack to get cauliflower wedges perfectly steamed and tender, before it’s added to a pan of beautifully crispy onions and served with richly spiced wholewheat cous cous and a topping of homemade cheese curds.

Privacy Preference Center

When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

Manage Consent Preferences

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Performance Cookies

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

Functional Cookies

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Targeting Cookies

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
